description: The study scene's windows behind the icons (built at runtime by wallpaper.rs, one per monitor, labelled wallpaper-<slot>-<n>): the events they listen to (settings:changed, power:display, companion:status, wallpaper:covered, wallpaper:fritz, widget:seen), nothing else. Their app commands (get_settings, power_display, companion_status, wallpaper_covered, wallpaper_fritz, widgets_now) are not ACL-checked without an app manifest, and must be granted here if one is ever added; wallpaper_covered and wallpaper_fritz check the calling window themselves. They are never given companion_config, a window's focus call, or anything that moves a window: the shell places them.
